$comment: Shared corpus for every native bridge implementation. direction names the receiver's view: frontendToNative is decoded by the native host, nativeToFrontend and reply by Studio. outcome is accept, malformed, unknownType, or unsupportedVersion. schemaValid marks a malformed case that only a decoder can detect. destinationIds lists an accepted catalog in display order. encodes names a message that a native encoder must reproduce exactly, and studioEncodes one that Studio's encoder must reproduce exactly. frontendCapabilities lists the capabilities a native host reads from an accepted frontend/ready. presentation lists what a native host decodes from an accepted presentation/open, with defaults applied. headerActionIds and headerMenuIds list the header a native host decodes from an accepted presentation/update. hostContext is the bridge context Studio reads from a config/get reply, or null when Studio refuses the negotiation.
